Looking for a Notepad++ alternative for Mac? Meet notePad++++, an independent Mac text editor, in this quick tour of real app features.

• Multiple tabs and column editing
• Multi-keyword search in any order, on the same line or in the same paragraph
• Markdown with linked scrolling between editor and preview, plus local image editing
• JSON and YAML structure previews, SQL hover previews, and HTML desktop/phone previews with orientation switching
• Built-in and custom text scripts, folder-wide change previews, backups and operation history
• Minimal Mode for focused writing
